qualifier: with mucopolysaccharidosis lysosomal degradation
name: Glycosaminoglycan turnover and O-glycosylation, including mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: Members cover CS/DS/HS/KS proteoglycan synthesis, O-mannosyl/fucosyl/glucosyl glycosylation (dystroglycan, Notch, TSR) and their defects; unlike the glycosylation confusables it adds the mucopolysaccharidosis GAG-degradation set, and unlike the lysosomal confusables it has the biosynthetic arm.

qualifier: PA, DAG/TAG and CDP-choline phosphatidylcholine
name: Glycerolipid biosynthesis via PA, DAG, TAG and CDP-choline
rationale: All members concern synthesis of phosphatidic acid, mono-/di-/triacylglycerol and phosphatidylcholine via the CDP-choline route and its regulation, whereas confusables cover other phospholipid classes and remodeling or triglyceride breakdown and lipid droplets.

qualifier: kinesin-driven vesicle and synaptic protein delivery
name: Kinesin-driven neuronal vesicle and synaptic protein transport
rationale: Members describe axonal/dendritic transport of dense-core vesicles, synaptic vesicles and receptor complexes by kinesins, distinguished from confusables centred on mitochondrial and endolysosomal organelle transport or tubulin modification.

qualifier: severing, barbed-end capping and Arp2/3 inhibition
name: Actin filament turnover via severing, capping and depolymerization
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization/depolymerization through severing, barbed-end capping and Arp2/3 restraint, unlike confusables about leading-edge protrusion, crosslinked networks or filopodial bundles.

qualifier: including fucosylation, sialylation and blood-group antigens
name: Glycoprotein and proteoglycan glycan biosynthesis, including fucosylation
rationale: Members span biosynthesis of GAG chains, O- and N-glycans, fucose/GDP-fucose, sialylation and ABO/Lewis antigens; confusables instead emphasise nucleotide-sugar transport, glycosphingolipids or lack the fucosylation and N-glycan arms.

qualifier: phenylalanine/tyrosine with BH4, histidine, threonine, proline
name: Phenylalanine-tyrosine, BH4, histidine, threonine and proline metabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid catabolic/biosynthetic pathways for aromatic amino acids with their BH4 cofactor, histidine, threonine, proline and glycine/glyoxylate, unlike confusables centred on serine, sulfur amino acids and vitamin B6.

qualifier: outflow tract, second heart field and great arteries
name: Heart morphogenesis with outflow tract and great-artery development
rationale: Members describe heart tube, ventricle and septum morphogenesis plus second heart field, cardiac neural crest, outflow tract and pharyngeal/pulmonary/coronary artery formation, which the valve-, trabecula- and conduction-focused confusables lack.

qualifier: plasminogen activation, fibrinolysis and MMP matrix degradation
name: Plasminogen activation, fibrinolysis and MMP-mediated matrix degradation
rationale: Members concern plasmin-driven fibrin clot dissolution and MMP-mediated collagen/elastin breakdown, distinguished from the contact-system/kallikrein and hyaluronan-degradation confusables.

qualifier: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome and IL-1 processing
name: Inflammasome-mediated IL-1 processing and inflammatory cytokine regulation
rationale: Members regulate IL-1, IL-6, TNF and TLR-driven cytokine output, and uniquely include NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome assembly and IL-1 precursor processing absent from the TLR-focused confusables.

qualifier: TLR3/TLR4 signaling enhancement
name: TLR3/TLR4-enhanced proinflammatory cytokine induction
rationale: Members positively regulate TLR3/TLR4 signaling and IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production; unlike confusables they lack inflammasome, TRIF death-signaling or TLR2/LPS-detection components.

qualifier: mesonephric duct and ureteric bud elongation
name: Mesonephric duct and ureteric bud development
rationale: Members cover nephric/mesonephric duct formation, ureteric bud elongation and ureter morphogenesis, distinct from confusables on ureteric bud initiation, branching and kidney growth regulation.

qualifier: fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control and lactate production
name: Glycolytic flux to lactate and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control
rationale: Members describe glycolysis, its regulation by fructose 2,6-bisphosphate and lactate fermentation, whereas confusables emphasise hypoxia/HIF, FOXO/AKT, gluconeogenesis or creatine energetics.

qualifier: male sex determination and testis differentiation
name: Sex determination, testis differentiation and reproductive tract development
rationale: Members cover sex determination, testis (Sertoli/Leydig) differentiation, germ cell migration and Mullerian/genital tract development, unlike confusables on ovarian cycle hormones, prostate, placenta or pancreas.

core: Germline and early embryo epigenetic control
qualifier: piRNA transposon silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Germline transposon silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members concern piRNA/KRAB-ZFP/HUSH retroelement silencing, imprinting, X inactivation and maternal mRNA decay with zygotic genome activation, whereas confusables are meiotic recombination and fertilization.

qualifier: muscle fiber differentiation and homeostasis
name: Skeletal myogenesis and muscle fiber differentiation
rationale: Most members describe myogenesis, skeletal fiber differentiation, muscle cell homeostasis and diaphragm development, distinguished from confusables on dystroglycan glycosylation, neuromuscular junction and muscle atrophy.

core: Vascular smooth muscle tone and blood pressure
qualifier: NO-cGMP, endothelin and catecholamine control
name: Vascular smooth muscle tone and blood pressure via NO-cGMP
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle contraction/relaxation and arterial pressure through NO-cGMP, endothelin and catecholamines, unlike confusables centred on renin-angiotensin metabolism or eNOS activation.

qualifier: ascorbate and H2O2-dependent thyroid hormone generation
name: Ascorbate metabolism and H2O2-dependent thyroid hormone generation
rationale: Members combine vitamin C/E handling with hydrogen peroxide production and thyroid hormone generation and transport, distinct from confusables on iron/selenium, generic ROS detoxification or thyroid hormone receptor signaling.

qualifier: vitamin K gamma-carboxylation, vitamin E, ubiquinol
name: Vitamin K gamma-carboxylation, vitamin E and ubiquinol metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation of clotting factors plus vitamin E and ubiquinone/quinone synthesis, distinguished from vitamin D, vitamin C and cholesterol-synthesis confusables.

qualifier: ephrin receptors and Rho GTPase filopodium control
name: Ephrin signaling and Rho GTPase control of filopodia
rationale: Members are ephrin/EPH repulsion and growth-cone collapse with RAC1/CDC42/RHOF regulation of filopodia and actin bundles, unlike confusables centred on netrin, SLIT-ROBO and L1 guidance.

qualifier: TNFR1 and NIK-dependent non-canonical arm
name: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB regulation via TNF receptors
rationale: Members regulate canonical and NIK-driven non-canonical NF-kappaB via TNFR1, CD40 and TNFSF receptors, distinct from deubiquitinase, TLR-IKK recruitment and EDA-ID confusables.

qualifier: nodal, His-Purkinje and gap-junction coupling
name: Cardiac conduction system development and electrical coupling
rationale: Members cover SA node, AV node/canal and His-Purkinje development with gap-junction electrical coupling and cardiomyocyte fate, absent from morphogenesis, myocardial growth and vascular confusables.

qualifier: PU.1 identity and monocyte activation
name: Myeloid lineage identity and monocyte activation
rationale: Nearly all members are monocyte/neutrophil identity and activation modules (PU.1, TLR4, ectoenzymes), distinguished from confusables on dendritic/surface signatures, CSF1 signaling or degranulation.

qualifier: chemotaxis, extravasation and formyl peptide receptors
name: Neutrophil chemotaxis and extravasation via formyl peptide receptors
rationale: Members regulate neutrophil/granulocyte chemotaxis, diapedesis and recruitment including formyl peptide receptor responses, unlike confusables on degranulation, respiratory burst and chemokine production.

qualifier: de novo purine and pyrimidine with NTP interconversion
name: De novo purine and pyrimidine nucleotide synthesis and interconversion
rationale: Members cover de novo IMP/AMP/GMP and pyrimidine synthesis plus nucleoside mono/di/triphosphate interconversion, distinct from confusables on nucleotide catabolism and deoxyribonucleotide metabolism.

qualifier: defensins and metal sequestration
name: Defensin and metal-sequestration antimicrobial defense
rationale: Members describe direct microbial killing and lysis by alpha/beta defensins, metal-chelating antimicrobials and mucosal innate defense, which confusables lacking defensins and metal sequestration do not share.
